title: Merge Intervals
prompt:
Merge all overlapping intervals and return the non-overlapping result sorted by start.

**Example**: `[[1,3],[2,6],[8,10],[15,18]]` → `[[1,6],[8,10],[15,18]]`.

The intervals template verbatim: sort by start, sweep, extend-or-append.

tests.note: fully contained — don't shrink the end!

hints: Overlap with the last kept interval: `cur[0] <= last[1]` → extend with `last[1] = max(last[1], cur[1])`.
The max matters for contained intervals like [1,4] ⊇ [2,3].

solution.explanation: O(n log n) for the sort, O(n) sweep. After sorting, an interval can only overlap the most recent group — so one comparison against the last kept interval decides extend vs. append.
